title: Rethinking Changing “Unethical” Names in Taxonomy: An Asian Perspective
content:
Abstract
Despite concerns from taxonomists, at least 300 plant and fungi names starting with caf[e]r- or caff[e]r- were changed to af[e]r- because of racial offensiveness. This comment offers a chronically overlooked Asian perspective on taxonomic ethics, highlighting gaps in global inclusivity and raising questions about practical challenges.
